title: A noiseless micro without common causes leaves no emergence

statements.text: Causal emergence vanishes when the microscale has zero uncertainty about the effects of causes and no common causes, as in a permutation matrix, a perfectly reversible deterministic dynamics.

sources.quote: So while causal emergence vanishes in the condition of a microscale possessing zero uncertainty about the effect of causes, and also possessing no common causes (e.g., like a permutation matrix)
such a system [where Eff(S) = 1] is perfectly retrodictive/predictive
